reported.title: Heartbeat blocked during siren pulse
reported.description: runSirenBurst() calls delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38, which blocks loop() for the full 2000 ms so the heartbeat check at lines 60-65 cannot run. Measured serial gaps of 2249 ms and 2200 ms far exceed the 250 ± 100 ms requirement, and the sirenArmed flag set at line 55 is never used to gate re-entry, so repeated or held presses extend the blackout. Expected /^hb$/ every 250 ± 100 ms; 5 of 8 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2249 ms.

reported.title: Firmware silent for 2000 ms during siren
reported.description: The blocking delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 halts all serial output and pin activity for 2000 ms, exceeding the 700 ms silence limit. Measured gaps of 2000 ms with no serial or pin activity occurred repeatedly, and a held-open door re-enters runSirenBurst() at line 56 each iteration, producing continuous blackout. Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).

judge_input.spec:
- Kiln door switch on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren driver on D8.
- A settled door-open press as short as 40 ms starts a 2000 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 150 ms.
- While a siren pulse is already running, additional presses are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 250 ms at all times, including during the siren pulse.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no pin change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle door contact reads HIGH.
